heading: AI work across fields
intro: Agents that staff their own jobs: a lead agent reads the brief, spins up a small team of purpose-built workers to research in parallel, then writes one report — with every model call, tool and self-check on the record.

badges.title: Agent Teams & Planning
points: A lead agent splits each research turn across 2–3 workers, by angle or by topic
Every worker is built on demand with its own persona, tools and live web search
The lead writes one combined report, then proposes the next moves
Rooted in MSc research on heuristic search and PDDL planning

badges.title: Guardrails & Safe Execution
points: Generated tool code is checked before it runs, then run in a locked-down, secret-free sandbox
Mission, allowed tools and limits are written as a spec and enforced in code
A separate judge call screens replies that stray out of scope

badges.title: Evals & Observability
points: Every reply, tool call and delegation is graded and tagged with the model behind it
Offline evals replay recorded tool responses, so model comparisons are repeatable
A case file shows each step's model, timing and tokens

badges.title: Provider Cascades & MCP
points: Fallback chains across Claude, Gemini, Cloudflare-hosted Qwen and local Ollama
One cascade shared to other sites as an MCP server, instead of rebuilt in each
Agents and JobFit tools published over MCP for Claude and other clients

badges.title: AI Inside the Product
points: JobFit ranks live job listings against a CV and hides the off-target ones
A daily digest email, where one click returns a tailored CV and cover letter
Typed, schema-validated outputs with a correction retry before any fallback

badges.title: Retrieval & Grounding
points: New agents are grounded on similar past builds, retrieved by embedding
Topics are embedded to flag near-duplicates and suggest related ones
Live context such as weather and news injected at generation time
